ranked_results.content: Neighbors-only. In this experiment, we replaced the GRU combine function (see Eq. DISPLAY_FORM14) with the identity function. That is, we simply have $\mathbf {H}^{t+1}$=$\mathbf {M}^{t+1}$. Since $\mathbf {A}$ has zero diagonal, by doing so, we completely ignore the previous feature of the node itself when updating its representation. That is, the update is based entirely on its neighbors. Except on Reuters (almost no change), performance always suffers, stressing the need to take into account the root node during updates, not only its neighborhood.
